text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I only changed code in `catalog/` and left the tests alone.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`. This also fixed `test_age`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the fee used `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It now uses `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` sliced `[-n - 1:]`, which returned one event too many. It now slices `[-n:]`.
- **`factory.py`:** I added the missing `Emma` book (Austen, 1815, 1 copy). I made up the author, year and copy count, since the tests only check the title.
